"""One place that knows how to reach an AI provider.

Every provider in this tutorial speaks the same dialect, so the only thing that
changes between OpenAI, Azure, Groq, OpenRouter and a model running on your own
laptop is three lines in a `.env` file.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from openai import OpenAI

load_dotenv()


class ConfigError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised with an instruction, not a stack trace."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    base_url: str
    api_key: str
    model: str
    vision_model: str

    @property
    def provider(self) -> str:
        host = self.base_url.split("//")[-1].split("/")[0].lower()
        for needle, label in (
            ("localhost", "Ollama (local)"),
            ("127.0.0.1", "Ollama (local)"),
            ("groq", "Groq"),
            ("openrouter", "OpenRouter"),
            ("azure", "Azure OpenAI"),
            ("api.openai.com", "OpenAI"),
            ("together", "Together"),
        ):
            if needle in host:
                return label
        return host


def load_settings() -> Settings:
    base_url = os.getenv("AI_BASE_URL", "").strip()
    api_key = os.getenv("AI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    model = os.getenv("AI_MODEL", "").strip()

    missing = [
        name
        for name, value in (
            ("AI_BASE_URL", base_url),
            ("AI_API_KEY", api_key),
            ("AI_MODEL", model),
        )
        if not value
    ]
    if missing:
        raise ConfigError(
            f"{', '.join(missing)} not set.\n"
            "Copy .env.example to .env and fill in one provider block."
        )

    return Settings(
        base_url=base_url,
        api_key=api_key,
        model=model,
        # Some providers use a separate model for pictures. Default to the
        # same one so the simple case needs no extra setting.
        vision_model=os.getenv("AI_VISION_MODEL", "").strip() or model,
    )


def get_client(settings: Settings | None = None) -> OpenAI:
    """The one object the rest of the program talks to."""
    settings = settings or load_settings()
    return OpenAI(
        base_url=settings.base_url,
        api_key=settings.api_key,
        timeout=120.0,
        max_retries=2,
    )

"""The single function every other module in this project calls.

This is deliberately the smallest useful wrapper around the API. If you delete
everything else in this project, keep this file - it is the whole idea.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable

from .config import Settings, get_client, load_settings


def ask(
    instruction: str,
    content: str,
    *,
    schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    images: Iterable[Path] | None = None,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
) -> str | dict[str, Any]:
    """Send one question and get one answer.

    instruction  what the AI should do        ("summarise complaints")
    content      what it should do it to      (the actual text / rows)
    schema       optional JSON shape you want back instead of prose
    images       optional pictures to look at
    """
    settings = settings or load_settings()
    client = get_client(settings)

    user_parts: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"type": "text", "text": content}]
    for path in images or []:
        user_parts.append(
            {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _as_data_url(path)}}
        )

    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": settings.vision_model if images else settings.model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": instruction},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_parts},
        ],
        "temperature": temperature,
    }

    if schema is not None:
        kwargs["response_format"] = {
            "type": "json_schema",
            "json_schema": {"name": "answer", "strict": True, "schema": schema},
        }

    try:
        response = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
    except Exception:
        if schema is None:
            raise
        # Not every provider supports a full JSON schema. The ones that don't
        # still support "just give me JSON", so describe the shape in words
        # and try once more instead of failing the whole run.
        kwargs["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
        kwargs["messages"][0]["content"] = (
            f"{instruction}\n\nReply with JSON matching this schema exactly:\n"
            f"{json.dumps(schema)}"
        )
        response = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)

    text = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
    return json.loads(text) if schema is not None else text


def _as_data_url(path: Path) -> str:
    """Turn a file on disk into the string the API expects for a picture."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No image at {path}")
    mime = mimetypes.guess_type(path.name)[0] or "image/png"
    payload = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode()
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{payload}"
files.profile_show.py:
"""Print the profile the way a person reads it."""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from analyst.data import profile

p = profile(Path("samples/orders.csv"))
cols = p["columns"]
print(f'orders.csv  ->  {p["row_count"]} rows, {len(cols)} columns')

for name in ("delivery_days", "courier", "status"):
    info = cols[name]
    print()
    print(f'{name:<16}{info["kind"]}')
    if info["kind"] == "number":
        for key in ("missing", "distinct", "min", "max", "mean", "stdev"):
            print(f'  {key:<10} {info[key]}')
    else:
        for value, count in info["top"]:
            print(f'  {value:<18} {count}')
files.check.py:
"""The one check that caught the bug: does the tool name the worst delay?"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from analyst.data import profile

results = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    results.append(ok)
    print(f'    [{"PASS" if ok else "FAIL"}] {name}' + (f" - {detail}" if detail else ""))


print("4. DATA: profile is computed in Python, not guessed")
p = profile(Path("samples/orders.csv"))
days = p["columns"]["delivery_days"]

check("row count is exact", p["row_count"] == 50, str(p["row_count"]))
check("delivery_days is numeric despite the blanks", days["kind"] == "number")
check("found the 2 undelivered orders", days["missing"] == 2, str(days["missing"]))
check("flagged the slow deliveries as outliers",
      days.get("outliers", 0) > 0, f'outliers={days.get("outliers")}')
check("named the worst delay, 19.4 days",
      19.4 in days.get("outlier_values", []), str(days.get("outlier_values")))

passed = sum(results)
print(f"  {passed} passed, {len(results) - passed} failed")
sys.exit(0 if passed == len(results) else 1)

"""Ground-truth check for the episode 3 hallucination claim."""

import csv
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[0]
rows = list(csv.DictReader((ROOT / "samples" / "orders.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="")))

lost = [r for r in rows if r["status"] == "lost_in_transit"]
print("lost_in_transit orders:")
for r in lost:
    print(f"  {r['order_id']}  region={r['region']}  courier={r['courier']}")

print("\nlost orders per courier:")
for c in sorted({r["courier"] for r in rows}):
    n = sum(1 for r in lost if r["courier"] == c)
    total = sum(1 for r in rows if r["courier"] == c)
    print(f"  {c:<10} {n} lost of {total} orders")

print("\nlost orders per region:")
for g in sorted({r["region"] for r in rows}):
    n = sum(1 for r in lost if r["region"] == g)
    print(f"  {g:<8} {n}")

print("\ndelivery_days by courier:")
for c in sorted({r["courier"] for r in rows}):
    v = [float(r["delivery_days"]) for r in rows
         if r["courier"] == c and r["delivery_days"]]
    print(f"  {c:<10} min {min(v):<6} max {max(v):<6} mean {sum(v) / len(v):.2f}  n={len(v)}")

print("\nVERDICT")
print("  model said : 'FarReach is responsible for 2 out of 2 lost_in_transit orders'")
print("  truth      : FarReach lost 0. Both lost orders are RapidPost, North region.")
print("  model said : 'two lost orders ... 20% of the orders from the Remote region'")
print("  truth      : 0 lost orders in Remote. Both are in North.")
